title: Seal merged Heim-PC source for cutover rehearsal
goal: After T009 is terminal, bind its exact terminal Captain merge receipt and independently read the exact T009 merge commit/tree from heimgewebe/heim-pc. Prove protected main still contains that merge commit and its exact T007/T006/T005/T001/T002 ancestry, then create artifact.heim-pc.nixos-published-source from the exact T009 merge-commit tree—not from a later moving main tip. The immutable manifest becomes T003’s sole declarative/reconstruction source. T010 performs no repository ref mutation, merge, source edit, NixOS activation or cutover effect.

approval.note: The only mutation is create-only publication of the immutable published-source artifact after exact T009 terminal merge-receipt validation. Git refs, PRs, main, code, runtime and production storage/boot state are read-only/outside authority.

acceptance.assertion: T010 begins only after T009 is terminal and independently reviewed. It binds the exact terminal T009/Captain receipt including repository, PR, reviewed head/base/diff, actual merge commit/tree and ancestry proof; any missing, nonterminal, mismatched or ambiguous receipt fails closed before artifact creation.

Fresh GitHub/Git readback proves protected heimgewebe/heim-pc main still contains the exact T009 merge commit as an ancestor. Later legitimate main commits may exist but are not silently incorporated into this source identity.

The exact T009 merge commit object/tree is independently read and rehashed; it contains exact T007/T006/T005/T001/T002 ancestry and the reviewed T008 publication tree plus the T009 protected merge parent relationship. A moving current-main tree is never substituted.

While holding the exclusive artifact.heim-pc.nixos-published-source write claim, T010 creates a content-addressed whole-source artifact from exactly the T009 merge-commit tree. Its immutable manifest binds T009 terminal receipt/Captain digests, PR, pre-merge base, reviewed head/tree/diff, actual merge commit/tree, predecessor ancestry, archive/content digest, Control Release Set and lock/input identity; immediate independent re-hash proves byte/tree identity.

Only after exact T009 merge containment and published-source artifact readback may typed Bureau workspace cleanup preflights classify T001/T002/T005/T006/T007/T008 source branches as contained by protected main. Cleanup remains a separate effect and never force-removes dirty, foreign or ambiguous workspaces.

T010 terminal evidence designates artifact.heim-pc.nixos-published-source as T003’s sole declarative/reconstruction source and binds its exact manifest/digest to the T009 merge commit/tree and predecessor ancestry. T003 must reject any alternate or moving source.

T010 creates no Git ref, PR, merge or source-code change and performs no NixOS activation, sgdisk, wipefs, cryptsetup luksFormat, mkfs, EFI/Secure-Boot/firmware mutation, productive nixos-install/switch or reboot.
